name: Arts & Hearts Academy
source:
You accidentally find yourself in a prestigious architectural competition, but this chance is crucial to you – only by winning can you get into the architecture academy of your dreams. However, your competitors show hostility, and even your teammates are very cold towards you. What's more, right after arriving at the academy, you discover the mysterious diary of a missing girl, and now you must solve the case.

Can you overcome your differences with the others and find love? Can you win the competition? Can you unravel the mystery of the missing girl?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2659250/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你无意中发现自己参加了一场著名的建筑竞赛，但这个机会对你来说至关重要——只有获胜才能进入你梦想的建筑学院。然而，你的竞争对手却表现出敌意，甚至你的队友对你也很冷淡。更重要的是，刚到学院，你就发现了失踪女孩的神秘日记，现在你必须侦破此案。

你能克服与他人的差异并找到爱情吗？你能赢得比赛吗？你能解开失踪女孩的谜团吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2659250/]Steam[/url]]
